<think>
The user wants me to write a detailed technical review of the records provided, covering measurement, storage, scheduling, and correctness, in at least 500 words. Let me analyze the records carefully.

First, let me identify the unique records (many are duplicated):

1. Cache reuse / bytes estimate vs physical memory traffic (Records 1, 11, 17)
2. Storage worker reads selected rows from lookup table, table larger than buffer (Records 2, 10, 19)
3. Evaluation stores complete request/response with build identifier, next run uses same data for comparability (Records 3, 7, 12, 21, 22, 25, 27)
4. Useful change reduces complexity while keeping accuracy/speed; faster on one input doesn't justify regression on another (Records 4, 13, 18, 20, 29)
5. Scheduler tracks each request separately, preserves correct state on finish/arrival (Records 5, 8, 24, 26)
6. Short vs long request follow different paths; report distinguishes time-to-first-answer from generation
